items.html: And it is found that until Hod descends — which is the food and the milk of ZA — to its true place, the time of eight Sefirot is needed, which are KHB HGTN. And corresponding to them are the first eight months; then the infant begins to stand on his feet. And corresponding to them, eight months for the Sefira of Yesod, and eight months for the Sefira of Malchut, which begin from Keter and descend to their place. That makes three times eight — twenty-four months of the Yenika, in which his NHY expanded in their place and finished being clarified, and he was completed in complete VAK.
